title: NeMo Guardrails checks for NeMo Relay
description: Checks tool calls with the /v1/hooks/nemo-relay endpoint of a NeMo Guardrails hooks server, started with nemoguardrails hooks-server.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the NeMo Guardrails hooks server, such as http://127.0.0.1:8100. It must not contain a username or password: send credentials in headers.

headers.description: Headers sent with every check, as an object of header names and string values, for a proxy or gateway in front of the hooks server, such as authorization. Values are treated as sensitive, so the plugin rather than this schema checks them: a schema error would quote the value. Headers the plugin's HTTP client controls, such as content-type and content-length, are rejected.

timeout_millis.description: Time limit for one check, in milliseconds. Keep it under the host's hook limit: 30 seconds for Claude Code and Codex hooks, 5 seconds by default for pi.

priority.description: NeMo Relay tool conditional-execution guardrail priority. Lower values run earlier.

executor.description: Optional NeMo Relay SDK executor override.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for the plugin's SDK-owned executor.
